description: Shear Behavior of PCI-UHPC Members Considering Size Effects is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Dimitrios Kalliontzis, University of Houston (uh.edu). This project investigated the size effects in ultra-high-performance concrete (UHPC) using the Universal Panel Tester (UPT) at the University of Houston. The experimental program included five shear panels of varying depths and widths, complemented by uniaxial tensile tests and fiber alignment analyses. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Ultra-high-performance concrete, UHPC, Universal Panel Tester, shear behavior, direct tension test, fiber alignment. Published 2025-04-15. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
